title: Direct Integrity Test Coverage
brief: Add direct tests for all 7 scoped engines. Assert degraded paths expose degraded status, unsupported paths don't return fake artifacts, no-op mutations can't report success. Target: >=80% branch coverage for scoped engines. Add audit script for ongoing regression detection.
